label: sec:nuclear-stability-decay-hadron-half-life-preamble
html: We continue the analysis of nuclear stability. We derive a substrate-level formula for the hadron half-life. The categorical q-self-correction provides the leading deviation from the classical Fermi formula. We define the hadron half-life. We derive the q-self-correction. We establish the skein-Coulomb enhancement governing the substrate-flow behaviour. We tabulate predictions against PDG values. We identify the optimal substrate-flow regime.
